text:
All sections (`header.json` and `units-001.json` through `units-005.json`) have been updated and accepted by `plan-lint`:

1. **Short 2-to-5-line edits in `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` (`U01` in `units-001.json`):**
   - Note: `plan-lint` enforces one unit per file path (`U02 (packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx): U01 already changes this file; one unit per file`), so `U01` replaces the earlier method-body sites with 9 short 2-to-5-line sites (`S1`–`S9`) anchored on unique lines without changing indentation of any method body:
     - `S1` (`240–243`) + `S2` (`446–448`): Move `ExcalidrawPage` import from `@excalidraw/element/types` to `../types` (fixes `updateScene` line 5203).
     - `S3` (`4521–4525`): Guard `this.scene.setActivePage` and `this.syncPageHistoryStacks` in `componentDidUpdate` when `activePageId` or the page id list changed from `prevState` (leaving lines `4405–4427` untouched).
     - `S4` (`5358–5359`) + `S5` (`5435–5437`): Declare `private withPageUpdate = <T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: T): T => fn;`, use `this.withPageUpdate(` on `addPage` (preserving 6-space body indentation while returning `ExcalidrawPage`), and cast `addPage`'s `this.setState` object `as Pick<AppState, keyof AppState>` (fixes line 5419).
     - `S6` (`5443–5444`) + `S7` (`5459–5460`): Replace `withBatchedUpdates(` with `this.withPageUpdate(` on `renamePage` and `reorderPages` (fixes lines 5443 and 5460 while preserving body indentation and 2nd arguments).
     - `S8` (`5554–5556`): Cast `deletePage`'s `this.setState` object `as Pick<AppState, keyof AppState>` (fixes line 5537).
     - `S9` (`12010–12014`): Pass `{ preservePageIds: elements.some((el) => Boolean(el.pageId)) }` in `window.h.elements.set`.

2. **All remaining test type errors covered (`U02`–`U04`):**
   - `U02` (`packages/element/tests/pages.test.ts` in `units-002.json`): Fixes lines `241` and `253` by passing `emptyScene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted()` (`SceneElementsMap`) instead of `emptyScene.getNonDeletedElementsMap()` to `AppStateDelta.applyTo`.
   - `U03` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` in `units-003.json`): Fixes lines `282`, `453`, and `576` by spreading `{ ...API.createElement(...), pageId: "page-2" }` (`S5`, `S7`, `S9`), along with `onExcalidrawAPI`, `addPage(...).id`, `exportScene`, `exportToClipboard`, and `SearchMenu` test updates.
   - `U04` (`excalidraw-app/tests/pages.test.tsx` in `units-004.json`): Fixes line `97` (`LocalData.resumeSave("collaboration")` instead of `"browser"`) and line `337` (`getSyncableElements(syncInvalidIndices([elPage1, elPage2]))`), along with `restoreAppState`/`restoreElements` and `firebaseSDK` + `socket.io-client` mocks.

3. **Snapshot steps gated on `dragCreate` and `selection` render counts (`U05`–`U07` in `units-005.json`):**
   - `U05` runs `yarn vitest run packages/excalidraw/tests/dragCreate.test.tsx packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx && yarn test:update packages/excalidraw/tests/contextmenu.test.tsx` after `U01`–`U04`, and `U06` (`history.test.tsx.snap`) and `U07` (`regressionTests.test.tsx.snap`) depend on `U05`.
